name: locale-suggestion-bar
title: Locale suggestion bar
description: A polite bar that offers the local version of the site once, with Switch and Stay actions, and leaves remembering the answer to you.
docs: Decide when to show it, for instance when Accept-Language names a language you have a version in and the page is another, and store the answer yourself: the bar never redirects, never guesses from an IP address and removes itself on any choice, so render it only if you have not asked before. suggested carries the question and the words of the buttons in the suggested language (switchLabel, stayLabel and closeLabel are all required, so nothing on the bar is left in English by accident), and its code becomes the lang of the region, so every word on the bar is pronounced right. When the buttons do not fit side by side on a narrow screen, Stay drops under Switch instead of being cut off. Switch is a link to suggested.href, so linkAs can be your router's Link; onSwitch, onStay (which gets current) and onDismiss are where you store the choice. The bar slides in once, and instantly under reduced motion. The callbacks are functions, so use the bar from a Client Component or pass Server Actions.
